versions.changelog:
- Improved documentation to clarify upload steps for using local files.
- Added reference link for more AI tools (https://tools.dreamfaceapp.com/home) in Quick Start.
- Simplified and reorganized API usage instructions for better readability.

dream-head-tail-to-video 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Generate 4-second videos from first and last frame images using a text prompt.
- Supports easy configuration with DREAMHEADTAILTOVIDEO_API_KEY.
- Output resolution options: 480p (default) or 720p.
- Integrates with Dreamface platform and Wan2.1 API.
